auth: Separate agent_token and browser_token; Authorization: Bearer. Server stores SHA256 token hashes; secrets never logged.

JOB.url: http/https, no userinfo; literal private IP/localhost denied for remote jobs
JOB.human_deadline_at: server ISO time or null; set on human_required

RESULT.url: final URL, same origin as job; no credentials
RESULT.title: max1000 chars
RESULT.text: visible extracted text limited to job.max_chars
RESULT.degraded: optional boolean; required true after human timeout
RESULT.quality: optional full|partial; required partial after timeout

events.resume: awaiting_human -> running only before server human_deadline_at
events.timeout: awaiting_human -> running only at/after server human_deadline_at; sets degraded=true

extension_rules: No cookies/debugger/webRequest permissions; no remote JS, no eval
Allow only original job origin; redirect to login IdP is not extracted; user logs in and returns
Local capture without a job is export-only; no cloud upload
Relay https only except loopback development URL; token stored storage.session, not sync
Core loop: automatic rendered capture -> ask human only if usable content blocked -> on human timeout resume automatic anonymous fallback; continue remaining jobs
First per-origin session consent authorizes automatic capture AND return to displayed relay for up to8h; scope stored in storage.session and revocable; no per-job approval for authorized scope
Before scope consent, new origin job waits without opening tab or reading page
Sufficient visible article content must not be blocked solely by a login overlay/password widget
human_required records server deadline; only resume before deadline, timeout at/after deadline; never pause whole queue
After timeout: no-cookie public fetch with bounded response/time, reject redirects to unapproved origins; partial real content yields degraded:true quality:partial; no content yields explicit failed
Sidepanel-open polling every2s; on closed panel/offline waits, after reconnect expired human jobs execute timeout fallback; persistent always-on cloud control not claimed
